summary: CloudAdapter real implementation is correct and consistent with LocalAdapter. Three findings: one minor correctness issue, two low-severity notes.

findings.title: Double connect() call — createEngine() for postgres may already connect internally
findings.description: createEngine({engine:'postgres', database_url}) constructs a PostgresEngine but does NOT call connect() internally (confirmed in engine-factory.ts — it just calls `new PostgresEngine()`). So the explicit `engine.connect({ database_url: url })` on line 71 is correct and necessary. However, the config passed to `createEngine` includes `database_url` which is unused by the factory (it only reads `engine` key). This is harmless but slightly misleading.
findings.suggestion: Could simplify to `createEngine({ engine: 'postgres' })` since database_url is passed to engine.connect() anyway. Minor cosmetic issue — existing code is functionally correct.

findings.title: clear() calls engine.deleteByUser() which does not exist on BrainEngine interface
findings.description: engine.deleteByUser() is not defined on the BrainEngine interface (confirmed via grep on engine.ts). LocalAdapter calls the same method via its `engine: any` typing. The CloudAdapter inherits the same pattern. This is a pre-existing issue with both adapters — not introduced in this task. The method may exist on a runtime-wrapped engine or be planned for a future task.
findings.suggestion: Add a code comment noting this method is expected on the runtime engine (matching the LocalAdapter comment pattern). Out of scope to fix in this task.
findings.reason: pre-existing issue shared with LocalAdapter; not introduced in task 5

findings.title: migrateAttestationsTable() now calls getEngine() which calls requireDb()
findings.description: The method guard `if (!db && !this.databaseUrl) return;` runs first, so migrateAttestationsTable() with no db arg and no databaseUrl will return silently. But when databaseUrl IS set, it calls getEngine() which calls requireDb() (redundant guard) — then connect() + initSchema() before running the DDL. This means calling migrateAttestationsTable() will initialise the full engine as a side effect. This is intentional and correct but could be surprising to callers who expect just the DDL, not full engine init.
findings.suggestion: Add a comment documenting that this method triggers full engine initialization as a side effect. Acceptable as-is.

notes: Implementation is solid. LocalAdapter/CloudAdapter symmetry is maintained. BM25 short-circuit in synthesize() is correct. ParsedCitation mapping is identical to LocalAdapter (verified). The deferred-throw pattern from Task 2 is correctly preserved.
